text:
Amy: Heads-up  Sequoia wants to evaluate swapping from CompetitorX to Redwood. They asked for a PoC + pricing and security answers. Can we outline a plan? :eyes:
Rafael: I can lead the technical PoC. Is parity the main ask or migration effort/cost?
Amy: Sales says parity first, then SLA/SSO, then unit cost. They've got a security questionnaire too.
Maria: Please drop the questionnaire PDF here so we can triage. Need to check KMS, audit logs, retention, VPC options. If they require on-prem that changes scope.
Amy: Uploaded secq: https://rwd.internal/secq/sequoia-2026.pdf
John: Pricing note  they expect a token-style billing similar to CompetitorX. Proposal: a 90-day PoC blended rate, then standard tiers. Need estimated tokens/day from them.
Olivia: Infra ask: dedicated PoC env with strict egress controls. We can provision dedicated pool; need CIDR + static IPs. How long to get staging live?
Sam: I can provision a sandbox dedicated cluster. ETA ~48 hours after we receive CIDR and service account. FYI the adapter shim for request parity will be a small proxy to normalize headers and rate-limits.
Rafael: For prompt parity testing we need a sample set of 500 prompts (they agreed). We'll run blind A/B vs CompetitorX, capture outputs, token counts, latency. Plan to produce a delta report highlighting functional/regression diffs.
Amy: Rafael, can you produce an eval harness and a compact report template?
Rafael: Yes. High-level plan:
1) Build shim proxy that accepts CompetitorX payloads and forwards normalized requests to Redwood.
2) Run A/B across 500 prompts (randomized, blind).
3) Record outputs, token usage, latencies, and failure modes.
4) Produce CSV + summary with examples of deltas and a severity tag.
Example shim curl test:
```
curl -X POST https://poc-sequoia.redwood-internal/api/v1/complete
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_KEY"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-compat","prompt":"<their prompt>","max_tokens":256}'
```
Rafael: We'll also include a fallback policy to a cheaper quantized variant for cost SLO experiments.
Maria: Security checklist items to answer: exact retention period for prompts, deletion workflow, SOC2 status, recent penetration test summary, and whether plaintext prompts are stored in logs. We also need to confirm KMS/HSM integrations.
John: I'll draft the pricing addendum (90-day PoC price + committed rate table). Also include overage billing clause for usage beyond the commitment. Need a QPS estimate to size reserved capacity.
Olivia: SLA question  they asked about p95 latency. We can offer p95 <200ms on dedicated pool for typical short prompts; caveat for long context.
Amy: Legal flagged two enterprise blockers: EU data residency for EU customers, and indemnity around hallucinations.
Maria: Residency: we can route EU traffic to eu-central during PoC. For indemnity, legal will propose standard carve-outs; we'll surface that to the customer.
Sam: Quick PoC ops checklist:
- receive CIDR + service account from Sequoia
- provision dedicated pool + shim proxy
- seed 500 prompts + test keys
- run smoke and perf tests
- deliver A/B results and summary
Olivia: I'll prepare dashboards (latency, token burn, error rates) and an alert runbook (who to page on incidents).
Amy: Sequoia asked for kickoff Tues and a 2-week PoC. Is that feasible?
Rafael: Two weeks is tight but do-able if infra and prompts are ready on day 0. Recommend a pre-kickoff tomorrow to confirm handoffs.
John: Also flag billing change: during PoC we should bill monthly but include clear termination and overage terms.
Maria: I'll redact and share SOC2 + pen test excerpts by EOD tomorrow for legal review.
deploy-bot: [deploy] sandbox cluster sequoia-poc created by sam_eng  48h pending IP allocations.
Amy: Great. Rafael, please post the eval harness repo link and a short runbook here when ready. I'll consolidate next steps in the customer email. :email:
Rafael: Will post repo + run instructions + expected CSV output by EOD.
Amy: Thanks team. Sync 11am PST tomorrow.
Sam: 44d
